model_annotation: Figure 3, titled “儿童长新闻数量饼图” (Pie Chart of Long Children’s News Articles), visually represents the proportional distribution of long-form news articles across different content categories within the constructed children’s news dataset. The chart is composed of seven distinct colored slices, each corresponding to a thematic category: “体育” (Sports), “社会” (Society), “榜样” (Role Models), “政治” (Politics), “文化” (Culture), “经济” (Economy), “科学” (Science), and “环境保护” (Environmental Protection). Although the exact percentage values are not labeled directly on the slices, the relative size of each segment visually conveys its proportion; for instance, “科学” and “社会” appear to be among the largest segments, while “经济” and “政治” are noticeably smaller. The chart uses a gradient color scheme ranging from blue to red to differentiate the categories, and no slice is visually emphasized through explosion or offset. A legend is not present within the figure itself, so the categories must be inferred from the context provided in the surrounding text and Table 4, which lists the absolute counts for each category. The chart’s purpose is to provide a quick visual summary of the thematic composition of the long-form children’s news corpus.
